He is the younger brother of [[Chloe]] and the son of [[Professor Cerise]] and [[Talia]]. ==History== [[File:Chloe family.png|thumb|left|250px|Parker and his family]] Parker first appeared in ''[[JN011|Best Friend...Worst Nightmare!]]'', where he tried to wake [[Chloe]] up for school. He then had breakfast together with his family before seeing his sister and [[Professor Cerise|father]] off as they drove to Chloe's school. In ''[[JN020|Dreams Are Made of These!]]'', Parker was among those who attended the [[Pokémon Orienteering]] competition at [[Cerise Laboratory]]. Alongside his sister, Parker followed [[Goh]] around [[Vermilion City]] and watched as he caught several Pokémon before meeting up with his father and the others. In ''[[JN029|There's a New Kid in Town!]]'', {{TP|Professor Cerise|Yamper}} brought home an injured {{p|Pidove}}. After Parker helped it recover, he was sad to see Pidove leave when its {{pkmn|Trainer}} came to pick it up. However, his sister comforted him and told him that Pidove's place was with its Trainer. In the end, Parker decided to say goodbye to Pidove next to his family. In ''[[JN031|The Cuteness Quotient!]]'', Parker asked Chloe, [[Goh]], and {{Ash}} to help him and his friend [[Jinny]] train her {{p|Feebas}}. Later, the group traveled to [[Hoenn]] to follow Jinny's performance at the [[Friendship Festival]]. Parker was invited to a sleepover party at Jinny's house some time before the events of ''[[JN057|Memories of a Warming Kindness!]]''. In a flashback, Parker tried to convince Yamper to go with him. Yamper in turn, only agreed to go after Chloe asked him to. Parker reappeared in ''[[JN067|Sleuths for Truth!]]''. In ''[[JN074|Nightfall? Nightmares!]]'', Parker was seen playing with Yamper while Chloe decided to travel to [[Sinnoh]]. In ''[[JN120|Infinite Possibilities!]]'', Parker joined his family on a camping trip. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Parker joined a party taking place at [[Cerise Laboratory]]. ==Character== In contrast to his [[Chloe|sister]], Parker is more open and friendly to {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, even trying to create a friendship between {{TP|Professor Cerise|Yamper}} and an injured {{p|Pidove}}. During the competition in ''[[JN020|Dreams Are Made of These!]]'', Parker was one of the children most impressed with [[Goh]]'s skills, which motivated him to want to know more about Pokémon. Parker seems to avoid being sincere, such as when he avoided responding to a question on what he thought of [[Jinny]]'s {{p|Feebas}} so as not to hurt his friend's feelings. ==Pokémon== ===Taking care of=== {{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Professor Cerise |pkmn=Yamper |type1=electric |gender=male |img=Cerise Yamper.png |epnum=JN002 |epname=Legend? Go! Friends? Go! |vajp=Inuko Inuyama |vaen=Tara Jayne{{!}}Tara Jayne Sands |desc={{p|Yamper}} is a Pokémon taken care of by Parker's family. Yamper sometimes alerts Parker to wake Chloe up when she is late for school. In ''[[JN057|Memories of a Warming Kindness!]]'', Yamper is Parker's choice to spend the night at [[Jinny]]'s house.
